newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Aug 4.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to shipping on Monday as Hurricane Guillermo distanced himself from Mexico's coast, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.

Guillermo was reported about 670 miles (1072 km) southwest of the Baja California coast. The ministry warned ships from sailing in the Pacific Ocean in the vicinity of the hurricane, where winds were 35 knots (39 miles/67 km per hour) and waves were 12 feet high.
"The Guillermo hurricane is expected to maintain its current intensity and move gradually away from the nation's coast," the ministry said.
The storm continued to send light rains to the coast.
Rains were also expected in the Gulf of Mexico along the Veracruz and Tamaulipas coast. Sunny skies prevailed in the region, the report said.
